A few things you might be wondering

Let's make
room for clarity.

Where should I start?+

Choose one space that feels hard to keep organized. Under a sink is a useful starting point: note what you store there, what gets lost, and which areas are difficult to reach. Our space brief helps you put those details together.

What about pipes and awkward shapes?+

Measure the usable interior, then note pipes, valves, hinges, and other obstacles. Any final design needs to keep plumbing and shutoff valves accessible. The illustrations show possibilities; they aren't installation plans.

Do I need exact measurements to begin?+

You can start with approximate measurements to organize your ideas. Label them as approximate in your notes. A final design and quote would need confirmed measurements, clearance checks, and an assessment of the actual space.

Can I order or get a price here?+

This is an early preview of the SpaceMax concept. You can explore the approach and download a space brief. Products, materials, pricing, and ordering are still to be finalized; no request, order, or payment is submitted on this site.
